en.headline: Ukrainian Culture Day brings bazaar, workshops and music to Goethe-Institut
en.dek: The one-day event on Saturday features a free handicraft bazaar, embroidery exhibitions, workshops, Ukrainian food and two live music performances in Wan Chai.
body: The Ukrainian Society of Hong Kong is holding Ukrainian Culture Day on Saturday at the Goethe-Institut Hongkong in Wan Chai, running from 1 p.m. to about 7:30 p.m. The programme centres on Ukrainian embroidery as a living cultural symbol and includes two exhibitions of contemporary posters and traditional work.

A handicraft bazaar in the Goethe-Gallery offers souvenirs, crafts and food, with free admission. Workshops and a photo area are also planned. All proceeds from the bazaar are intended to support people affected by the war in Ukraine, according to the organisers.

Two live music performances titled From Heart to Heart, featuring Nazar Tabachyshyn, the Kori Quartet and Olena Tyrtychna, take place in the Black Box Studio at 2:30 p.m. and 4:30 p.m. Tickets for the concerts are sold separately. The event is co-presented with the Goethe-Institut Hongkong.

zh.headline: 烏克蘭文化日歌德學院舉行 設市集工作坊及音樂會
zh.dek: 香港烏克蘭協會周六於灣仔歌德學院舉辦一日活動，包括免費手工藝市集、刺繡展覽、工作坊、美食及兩場現場音樂演出。
body: 香港烏克蘭協會周六於灣仔香港歌德學院舉行烏克蘭文化日，時間由下午1時至約7時半。活動以烏克蘭刺繡作為文化象徵，並設有當代海報及傳統作品兩項展覽。
歌德藝廊內的手工藝市集售賣紀念品、工藝品及食物，免費入場。另設工作坊及拍照區。主辦單位表示，市集收益將用於支援受戰爭影響的烏克蘭人士。
黑盒子劇場下午2時半及4時半各有一場名為「From Heart to Heart」的現場音樂演出，由Nazar Tabachyshyn、Kori Quartet及Olena Tyrtychna演出，音樂會門票另行發售。活動由香港歌德學院協辦。
